channel.title: Runway Briefing
channel.description: Your daily five-minute briefing on the aviation industry — new routes, airline strategy, fleet orders, and the moves shaping how we fly. Delivered daily like a friend catching you up over coffee.
channel.itunes:author: Runway Briefing

item.title: Episode Title: United and American Play Chicken Over Routes, Air Canada's Fancy New Jet Flops, and Frontier Guts Its Elites
item.description: United and American both dropped their summer route announcements this week, and things got a little spicy when United's CEO predicted American will eventually get run out of Chicago entirely. Plus, Air Canada's brand-new A321XLR couldn't hack its highest-profile route, Frontier takes another swing at its loyalty program, and Etihad has some explaining to do after a mid-air medical emergency.

item.title: Runway Briefing — United's Rough Day, Kirby's Chicago Prediction, and Frontier Plays Both Sides
item.description: A United flight from LA to Newark turns into a two-stop odyssey after an engine issue forces a diversion to Vegas. United's CEO doubles down on his prediction that American will eventually bail on Chicago. Frontier makes Diamond status easier to reach while quietly gutting everyone else's perks. Plus, Boeing's engineers just said "no thanks" to the latest contract, and two air traffic controllers are getting fired over the LaGuardia crash.
